train_ppo_policy: train a PPO policy for MountainCarContinuous-v0 using JAX, Flax, and Optax with configurable hyperparameters
create_batch_manager: create a BatchManager to manage rollout buffers with GAE lambda discounting for PPO training
calculate_gae_advantages: calculate Generalized Advantage Estimation advantages and targets from values, rewards, and done signals
run_rollout_evaluation: run a vectorized batch evaluation of the trained policy across multiple MountainCarContinuous environments
compute_actor_critic_loss: compute the combined PPO actor and critic loss with clipped value targets and entropy regularization
